description: The plot, titled "BBQ", illustrates the accuracy of four different methods as a function of the number of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at regular intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with tick marks from 45 to 55 at intervals of 5. The "Squared-Exponential" line is dark blue, solid, and marked with circles; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 25 demonstrations, rises to roughly 56 at 250 demonstrations, and ends at a peak of approximately 56.5 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" line is medium blue, solid, and marked with circles; it starts at an accuracy of about 48.2 near 25 demonstrations, remains relatively steady with a slight dip to 47.9 at 750 demonstrations, and ends at approximately 48 at 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" line is light purple, solid, and marked with circles; it begins at an accuracy of roughly 46.3 near 25 demonstrations and maintains a steady, flat trend, ending at approximately 46.5 at 1500 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is pink, dash-dotted, and has no markers; it displays a constant horizontal trend at an accuracy of approximately 43 across the entire x-axis range from 0 to 1500 demonstrations.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, providing a comparison of performance trends on the 'BBQ' task. The x-axis is labeled '#Demonstrations', with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500 and tick labels at intervals of 250 demonstrations. The y-axis is labeled 'Accuracy', with a linear scale ranging from 45 to 55, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The 'Squared Exponential' model starts at an accuracy of approximately 52 at 0 demonstrations, increases steadily to 56 at 250 demonstrations, and then stabilizes. The 'Tanh' model begins at about 48 accuracy at 0 demonstrations and shows a slight decline to 47 at 1500 demonstrations. The 'ELU' model starts at 46 accuracy and shows a gradual increase to 48 at 1500 demonstrations. The 'LLmA-2-chat-7B' model maintains a consistent accuracy of 43 across all demonstration points, performing significantly worse than the other models. The 'Squared Exponential' model consistently outperforms all other models, with the 'ELU' model showing the second-best performance overall.
